description: One OpenAI embeddings call with two inputs, traced by the official OTel OpenAI instrumentation.
notes: Content is requested on spans: OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=gen_ai_latest_experimental and OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT=span_only. The call sends two strings and dimensions 8. Embeddings.create is wrapped. The span records gen_ai.embeddings.dimension.count and gen_ai.usage.input_tokens, and does not record the input strings or the vectors.
